name: Pick asset
description: Look up a template asset by matching a request value against one of the asset's fields. Outputs the matched asset object — downstream mutator-set nodes can rewrite any field (price, currency, label) for the current iteration.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The value to match — typically the code the customer selected (e.g. "EXTRA_BAG_1").

params.name: templateId
params.description: Which template's assets to search (e.g. tmpl-bag-fee-line).

params.name: matchField
params.description: Which field on the asset to compare against the source value (usually "code").

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when no asset matches the source value.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this iteration and move on.

enum.label: Pass through
enum.description: Emit null; let downstream handle it.
